about_the_game:
Core Combat Team "is a mild roguelike game centered on workplace survival - from the moment you step into the office as a newcomer, you are automatically assigned the identity of" core combat team "by the system: perhaps the first" scapegoat "when taking the blame, perhaps the" warning chicken "pushed out when mediating conflicts, or the" troublemaker "who disrupts the situation in departmental chaos. Each identity corresponds to completely different survival rules.

Your goal is simple: to live through year after year of escalating workplace crises. At first, you were just a young person who always felt that time passed quickly. You needed to defeat the monsters that came one after another in a limited amount of time, level up, collect more money, and improve your strength through various means (or buy insurance?).

After all, in today's workplace, there are far fewer people who can retire smoothly than the warriors who complete the game. In 'Core Combat Team', you can restart time and time again, explore your own way of survival in the 'workplace', and perhaps find inspiration to deal with challenges in the real workplace.

It is worth mentioning that the creation of this game was inspired by "Potato Brothers" - the design logic of constantly trial and error with limited resources and finding the optimal solution through repeated challenges, allowing us to cleverly combine the absurdity of workplace survival with the randomness of roguelike.
